title: Katboocha
specs: No added sugar. No added probiotics. No unnecessary extras.
blurb: Katboocha brews kombucha using fewer ingredients, traditional fermentation, and balanced flavors. They use no added sugar or probiotics, just tea, water, sugar, culture, and time. The kombucha is crafted in the Finger Lakes and brewed to be enjoyed one sip after another.
highlights: No added sugar. No added probiotics. No unnecessary extras.
